name: LoginPage
title: Full sign-in / register page (Better Auth-wired)
description: A complete, centered auth page wired to Better Auth: email+password sign-in and register (signInWithPassword / registerWithPassword), a Google button, inline errors, and the dev-only 'Sign in as…' persona switcher. Toggles login/register in place. Use as the /login route body — takes an onAuthed callback to redirect after auth.

i18nKeys.loginpage__toggle_login: Already have an account? Sign in
